experiment: Exp 16: cross-domain Wiener-damped BiasCorr and AffineCorr (a_i*yhat_i + b_i), 7 quantized formats, 2 models, true causal SDPA

formulas_as_run.calibration: P = 1024 WikiText-2 TRAIN tokens, C = 1024 stdlib tokens (decimal/fractions/statistics [512,1536)), 2x512 rows each, pos0 excluded (1022 each), BF16 teacher-forced layer inputs
formulas_as_run.e: e = y - yhat = x (W - What)^T ; delta_b = mean(e)
formulas_as_run.gamma_proj: clip(<dbP,dbC> / (0.5(|dbP|^2+|dbC|^2) + 1e-12), 0, 1), float64; gamma_chan is the same per output channel
formulas_as_run.a_raw: Cov(y,yhat)/(Var(yhat)+1e-8) on pooled P+C, centered; clip [0.85,1.15]
formulas_as_run.gamma_a: same ratio on vectors (clip(a_P)-1) and (clip(a_C)-1); a_w = clip(1 + gamma_a (a_raw_unclipped - 1), 0.85, 1.15)

arms.WienerAffineCorr: a_w yhat + gamma_proj (ybar - a_w yhatbar)  [primary hypothesis arm]
arms.DIAG_AffineCentered_wienerA_wienerShiftO: a_w yhat + (1-a_w) yhatbar + gamma_proj db  [added diagnostic: does not shrink the gain re-centering term]

formulas_as_run.application: gain and bias applied in FP32 after the BF16 F.linear output, then cast to BF16

statistics.bootstrap: paired, 64 contiguous blocks (4 windows x 16 blocks of 32/31 tokens), resampled within window, 10000 draws, seed 20261125
statistics.multiplicity: 154 arm-vs-DF comparisons were computed without correction; stress_test adds a Bonferroni-level interval (level 0.999675, 400000 draws) for headline contrasts
statistics.not_covered: calibration-sample variance (one P and one C draw), eval-window selection (4 windows per domain), generation quality
